name: SDK secret source registry contract

test_list.description: Environment locations accept only 1 to 64 ASCII uppercase letters, digits, and underscores.
Keyring service and account names are bounded nonempty values without control characters.
Validated locations contain identifiers only and never accept or retain credential values.
SDK source failures have fixed sanitized displays and do not retain backend messages.
Unavailable backends are transient while unsupported or invalid operations are permanent.

inputs.name: reference
inputs.description: A keyring service/account or environment variable identifier, never a credential value.

output_description: A bounded validated source location that can be used by the SecretSource registry contract.
